name: Contentful
description: Contentful describes itself as a Digital Experience Platform (DXP) using AI-driven analytics to help organizations manage, personalize, and optimize digital content across multiple channels and touchpoints.
best_for: Contentful positions itself for growth marketing teams, product and developer teams, content teams, and mid-market/enterprise organizations needing centralized, multi-channel content management.

alternatives.name: Sanity
alternatives.description: A headless CMS / content operating system for structured content managed via schema-as-code and APIs.
alternatives.best_for: Development teams needing structured, API-first content across web, mobile, and other surfaces.

alternatives.name: Webflow
alternatives.description: A visual site builder with a built-in CMS, hosting, and AI-driven optimization.
alternatives.best_for: Marketers and designers who want visual site control paired with a CMS.
